paite: Midiktat amang zel a, kuamah in alungsim un angaihtuah kei uh, Pathian limsak mite lakmang in a-om ua, midiktat thil hoih lou hong tung ding a kipan lakmang ahi uh chih kuamah in angaihtuah kei uhi.
heading: Israel Milim Biakna Mohpaih Ahi
english: The righteous perishes, and no man lays it to heart; and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil.

paite: Lungmuanna ah alut ua; alupnate uah alum tawldam zel ding uh, diktak a pai peuhmahte.
english: He enters into peace; they rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness.

paite: Himahleh nou bumsiamnu tapa, angkawm leh kizuak suante aw, hiai ah hon naih un.
english: “But draw near here, you sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the prostitute.

paite: Nuihza bawlna dia na zat zel uh kua eita? Kua na maiphen khum ua, na lei khatkhum ua? Tatlekna ta, zuautheihna suante na hi kei uh maw?
english: Against whom do you sport yourselves? Against whom do you make a wide mouth, and stick out your tongue? Aren’t you children of disobedience, a seed of falsehood,

paite: Nou tosaw lak a, singbuk nuai teng a milimte toh kithoh a suangpi kawl lak nuai a phaizang sung a naupang that zelte.
english: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; who kill the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?

paite: Lui Phaizang suang mam lak ah na tantuan a-om a; huaite, huaite ngeingei na tantuan ahi; huaite a ding in dawn thillat na sung a, thilpiak na lan hi. Huai thil ah hihlungkim in ka om ding hia?
english: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion; they, they are your lot; you have even poured a drink offering to them. You have offered an offering. Shall I be appeased for these things?

paite: Tang sang zou mahmah tung ah na lupna na koih a; huai lai mah ah kithoihna lan ding in na hohtou zel hi.
english: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed; there also you went up to offer sacrifice.

paite: Huan kongkhakte leh kongbiang liahte ah na theihgigena na tung a; kei a ding hilou in midang a ding in na kisuah a, na hohtou ngal a; na lupna na kek a, akiang uah thu na khung a; alupna uh lah na muhna ah na it hi.
english: Behind the doors and the posts you have set up your memorial: for you have uncovered to someone besides me, and have gone up; you have enlarged your bed, and made you a covenant with them: you loved their bed where you saw it.

paite: Huan sathau toh kumpipa kiang ah na hoh a, na gimlimte lah na bawl thupi diakdiak a, gamlapi ah na palaite na sawl a, sheol pha hial in na niamsak hi.
english: You went to the king with oil, and increased your perfumes, and sent your ambassadors far off, and debased yourself even to Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. .

paite: Na paina lampi sau ziak in na gim a; himahleh, “Lametna himhim a-om kei, na chi ngal kei a; na hatna halhsakna na mu a; huaiziak in na bahta kei hi.
english: You were wearied with the length of your way; yet you didn’t say, ‘It is in vain.’ You found a reviving of your strength; therefore you weren’t faint.

paite: "Kua na kihta in na lau, zuau na gen nak a, kei na hon theih tak louh a, na lungsim a na ngaihtuah tak louh mai? Sawtpi ka dai dide kei maw? Kihtak leng na hon kihtak louh, TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Of whom have you been afraid and in fear, that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I held my peace even of long time, and you don’t fear me?

paite: Na diktatna leh na thilhihte ka gen ding; bangmah lah na loh tak kei dia.
english: I will declare your righteousness; and as for your works, they shall not profit you.

paite: Na kikou chiang in na lak khawmte'n hon humbit uheh; himahleh huih in amaute ala ding a, hu in amut vek ding; kei hon muang in bel gam anei ding a, ka tang siangthou aluah ding.
english: When you cry, let those who you have gathered deliver you; but the wind shall take them, a breath shall carry them all away: but he who takes refuge in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain.”

paite: Ama'n, "Sungvum un, sungvum un, lampi bawl un, ka mite lampi bawl un, ka mite lampi a kipan pukna ding pai un," TOUPA'N achi.
heading: Pathian Panpihna Leh Hihdamna Thuchiam
english: He will say, “Cast up, cast up, prepare the way, take up the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.”

paite: Mitungnung, tawisang, tang-tawn a om, amin Siangthou in hichi in achi ngal a, “Kei mun tungnung leh siangthou ah ka om a, mithunuailutte lungsim hihhalh ding leh kisik tuntunte lungtang hihhalh ding in mi lungsim a kisik tuntun a thunuailuttak kiang ah leng ka om hi.
english: For thus says the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.

paite: Tangtawn a dou lou ding ka hi, ka heh gige sam kei ding hi; huchi keileh mi lungsim ka ma ah abah ding a, hinna ka bawlte leng abah ding uh.
english: For I will not contend forever, neither will I be always angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls who I have made.

paite: Ahuaiham a athulimlouhna ziak in ka heh a, ka sat a, ka mai ka hum a, ka heh ahi; amah lah alungtang omdan ngeingei in paupengtak in a-om hi.
english: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I angry, and struck him; I hid myself and was angry; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.

paite: "A-omdante ka mu a, amah ka damsak ding; ka pi ding a, amah leh asuunpih mite kiang ah lungmuanna ka pe nawn ding.
english: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.

paite: Ke'n muk gah ka siam hi. Lemna, lemna, gamlapi a om kiang ah leh naichik a om kiang ah om hen," TOUPA'N achi, “Amah ka damsak ding.
english: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says Yahweh; “and I will heal them.”

paite: Mithulimloute bel tuipi kihot gige bang ahi uh; a-om kinken thei ngei kei a, atuite'n lah nin leh buannawi avikkhe zel uh," chi in.
english: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can’t rest, and its waters cast up mire and dirt.

paite: Ka Pathian in, “Mithulimloute a ding in muanna himhim a-om kei," achi hi.
english: “There is no peace,” says my God, “for the wicked.”
